show.description: A poor but determined girl’s life turns upside down when a powerful CEO from her past forces her into a contract marriage, sparking a storm of secrets, betrayal, and forbidden love. As family rivalries and hidden truths unfold, she must fight for her dignity, her mother’s life, and her own heart.
